title: Generate four options from a Story, with a prompt
description: Generate four candidates from the Story and an optional prompt, each saved to the publication's media with its prompt and model recorded. Reload generates four more. Credentials go in SSM as a SecureString, generated by infrastructure. No quotas or usage limits here: those belong to the separate billing initiative.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Duplicates the candidate generation in PPY-c101a6 (image toolchain design, project/wiki/image-toolchain.md). Fold it into PPY-c101a6; note that four options is for people, one image for agents. Not closed yet: decide when the work is picked up.
